+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"errors"

+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         bool
+	headers         []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	cookies         []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	queryParameters []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	filterState     []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	sourceIp        *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.headers, otherCH.headers, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) bool {
+		if a.HeaderName != b.HeaderName || a.Terminal != b.Terminal {
+			return false
+		}
+		if (a.RegexRewrite == nil) != (b.RegexRewrite == nil) {
+			return false
+		}
+		if a.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if a.RegexRewrite.Pattern != b.RegexRewrite.Pattern || a.RegexRewrite.Substitution != b.RegexRewrite.Substitution {
+				return false
+			}
+		}
+		return true
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.cookies, otherCH.cookies, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) bool {
+		if a.Name != b.Name || a.TTL != b.TTL || a.Path != b.Path || a.Terminal != b.Terminal {
+			return false
+		}
+		return slices.EqualFunc(a.Attributes, b.Attributes, func(x, y kgateway.CookieAttribute) bool {
+			return x.Name == y.Name && x.Value == y.Value
+		})
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.queryParameters, otherCH.queryParameters, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) bool {
+		return a.Name == b.Name && a.Terminal == b.Terminal
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.filterState, otherCH.filterState, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) bool {
+		return a.Key == b.Key && a.Terminal == b.Terminal
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}

+		}
+	}

+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if c.disable {
+		if len(c.headers) > 0 || len(c.cookies) > 0 || len(c.queryParameters) > 0 || len(c.filterState) > 0 || c.sourceIp != nil {
+			return errors.New("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {

+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return errors.New("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	headers := deduplicateHeaders(ch.Headers)
+	cookies := deduplicateCookies(ch.Cookies)
+	qps := deduplicateQueryParameters(ch.QueryParameters)
+	fs := deduplicateFilterState(ch.FilterState)
+
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, ck := range cookies {
+		if ck.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseCookieTTL(ck.TTL); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	var sourceIp *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		sourceIp = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         false,
+		headers:         headers,
+		cookies:         cookies,
+		queryParameters: qps,
+		filterState:     fs,
+		sourceIp:        sourceIp,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ir *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ir == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if ir.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = ir.buildHashPolicies()
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) buildHashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: h.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.GetHeader().RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, ck := range c.cookies {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ck.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+					Name: ck.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != "" {
+			if ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(ck.TTL); err == nil && ttl != nil {
+				hp.GetCookie().Ttl = ttl
+			}
+		}
+		if ck.Path != "" {
+			hp.GetCookie().Path = ck.Path
+		}
+		if len(ck.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(ck.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range ck.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			hp.GetCookie().Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, qp := range c.queryParameters {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: qp.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, fs := range c.filterState {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: fs.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if c.sourceIp != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: c.sourceIp.Terminal,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, hp)
+	}
+
+	// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false if no sub-fields specified
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: false,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}

+func deduplicateHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(headers))
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, 0, len(headers))
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		lower := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if _, ok := seen[lower]; !ok {
+			seen[lower] = struct{}{}
+			res = append(res, h)
+		}
+	}
+	return res
+}

+func unionHeaders(higher, lower []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(higher) == 0 && len(lower) == 0 {

+	combined := append(slices.Clone(higher), lower...)

+
+func cloneConsistentHash(in *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if in == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         in.disable,
+		headers:         slices.Clone(in.headers),
+		cookies:         make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie, len(in.cookies)),
+		queryParameters: slices.Clone(in.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     slices.Clone(in.filterState),
+	}
+	for i, c := range in.cookies {
+		out.cookies[i] = c
+		out.cookies[i].Attributes = slices.Clone(c.Attributes)
+	}
+	for i, h := range in.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			out.headers[i].RegexRewrite = &kgateway.RegexRewrite{
+				Pattern:      h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if in.sourceIp != nil {
+		out.sourceIp = &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{
+			Terminal: in.sourceIp.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if ttl == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttl)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must be non-negative: %s", ttl)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration format or integer seconds", ttl)
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p1 == nil || p2 == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = cloneConsistentHash(p2.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	higher := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	lower := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge {
+		higher = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		lower = p1.spec.consistentHash
+	}

+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		if higher == p2.spec.consistentHash {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	mergedHeaders := unionHeaders(higher.headers, lower.headers)
+	mergedCookies := unionCookies(higher.cookies, lower.cookies)
+	mergedQPs := unionQueryParameters(higher.queryParameters, lower.queryParameters)
+	mergedFS := unionFilterState(higher.filterState, lower.filterState)
+

+		}

+	p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         false,
+		headers:         mergedHeaders,
+		cookies:         mergedCookies,
+		queryParameters: mergedQPs,
+		filterState:     mergedFS,
+		sourceIp:        mergedSourceIP,
+	}
+
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
